k:押.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) hover over a button labelled wherefore (由). Nobody knows wherefore it is there, so every passing hand gives it a firm press to find out. Push (stop, check, subdue).

k:即.mnemonic: A stubborn (艮) gatekeeper refuses to budge until he sees a stamp (卩). Show him the stamp and the barrier flies up at once, no waiting. Instant (namely, as is, conform).

k:節.mnemonic: Bamboo (竹) shoots up in an instant (即), then pauses and leaves a knuckle on the stalk before the next spurt. Each knuckle marks one period of growth. Node (season, period, occasion).

k:途.mnemonic: A book (本) jammed in (介) a crack in the rock beside the path (辶): a guidebook wedged there so every walker can check the route ahead. Way (route, road, path).

k:聖.mnemonic: An ear (耳) and a mouth (口) sitting above a king (王). The one who hears heaven and speaks its words ranks higher than even the king. Holy (saint, sage, master).
k:聖.hint: Ear and mouth above a king.

k:拠.mnemonic: You trudge (夂) up to a sturdy table (几), grip its edge with your fingers (扌) and plant one boot on top. The table is your base for climbing higher. Foothold (based on, follow, therefore).

k:替.mnemonic: Two husbands, husband (夫) beside husband (夫), stand over one day (日) of chores. One does the morning, then hands the apron to the other for the afternoon. Exchange (spare, substitute).

k:厚.mnemonic: Under an overhang (厂) on a freezing day (日), a child (子) is bundled in so many quilts that he is as wide as he is tall. Thick (heavy, rich, kind).

k:帝.mnemonic: One figure stands (立) at the very top, a crowned forehead (冖) above the whole city (市) spread out below. Whoever stands over the city like that rules it. Sovereign (the emperor, god, creator).
k:帝.hint: Crowned figure standing over the city.

k:鬼.mnemonic: A big square head with a little horn on top, two spindly legs trailing off below, and a curled tail hooking up behind. A horned spirit drifting past in the dark. Ghost (devil).
k:鬼.hint: Horned head, trailing legs, curled tail.

k:仏.mnemonic: A leader (亻) sits beside a cocoon (厶), perfectly still, legs folded, waiting without hurry for what is inside to awaken. A leader with that much peace is enlightened. Buddha (the dead, France).

k:危.mnemonic: A cradle (勹) balanced on the very lip of an overhang (厂), and beneath it a warning stamp (卩) nailed to the cliff: keep away, it could tip at any moment. Dangerous (fear, uneasy).

k:魔.mnemonic: A ghost (鬼) hiding under a cloak of hemp (麻). Wrap a ghost in rough hemp cloth and give it a cauldron, and the village has another name for it. Witch (demon, evil spirit).
k:魔.hint: A ghost in a hemp cloak.

k:複.mnemonic: You trudge (夂) to work in the same cloak (衤) every day (日), so you buy a second one exactly like it to wear while the first is in the wash. Duplicate (double, compound, multiple).

k:倍.mnemonic: A leader (亻) stands (立) on a crate and opens his mouth (口): 'Follow me and I will pay you twice the wage!' The crowd in front of him grows to twice its size. Double (twice, times, fold).

k:刻.mnemonic: A person (人) hunched over a wooden block with a knife (刂), cutting tiny grooves one after another until a name stands out in the wood. Engrave (cut fine, chop, mince).
k:刻.hint: Knife cutting a name in wood.

k:脱.mnemonic: After a month (月) in the same clothes, elder brother (兄) finally peels them off, hair sticking up like two horns as the shirt comes over his head. Undress (removing, escape from, get rid of).

k:跡.mnemonic: A leg (足) that has stepped in red (赤) paint. Every stride leaves a bright red footprint on the floor, a trail anyone could follow. Tracks (mark, print, impression).

k:輸.mnemonic: A car (車) stacked with crates. The driver slits each one open with a knife (刂) to check it, because goods ordered a month (月) ago must be on the road now (今). Transport (send, deliver).
k:輸.hint: Loaded car, crates checked by knife.

k:梅.mnemonic: A tree (木) that blossoms every (毎) year before all the others, while snow is still on the ground. Its sour fruit gets pickled every summer. Plum.
k:梅.hint: First tree to blossom every year.

k:季.mnemonic: A child (子) stands under the grain (禾), measured against it. The grain sprouts, towers over the child, is cut down, and sprouts again: four turns to every year. Seasons.
k:季.hint: Child measured against the growing grain.

k:闘.mnemonic: Inside the gate (門) two neighbours argue over a measurement (寸) of beans (豆): one swears the scoop was short. Soon beans are flying and sleeves are rolled up. Fight (war, battle).

k:枚.mnemonic: Strike (攵) a tree (木) with a cleaver and thin flat boards peel off, to be counted one by one: a board, a page, a slice. Sheet of...
k:枚.hint: Thin flat boards off a tree.

k:樹.mnemonic: In the middle of the village (村) someone pressed beans (豆) into the soil (土). The beanstalks thickened into great trunks, and now a standing forest splits the village in two. Timber (trees, wood, establish).

k:冷.mnemonic: Orders (令) come down from the innkeeper: leave the bottles outside until icicles (冫) hang from them. Only then is the drink fit to serve. Chill (cool, cold).

k:昇.mnemonic: The day (日) begins: twenty (廾) hands haul on a thousand (千) ropes to hoist the sun over the horizon, and up it goes. Rise up.

k:適.mnemonic: A speaker's podium (啇) set on the path (辶) and turned facing (向) the crowd, at exactly the right height and angle. Everything about it fits the occasion. Suitable (qualified, capable, occasional).

k:垣.mnemonic: A bank of soil (土) planted with bushes so tall that dawn (旦) reaches the garden only once the sun has climbed over the top of it. Hedge (fence, wall).
k:垣.hint: Dawn climbing over a leafy bank.

k:魚.mnemonic: A pointed head at the top, a body marked with scales like a little grid, and four flicks of tail at the bottom. Hung up by the nose at the market. Fish.
